aso-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：阿索萨机场的跑道铺在埃塞俄比亚西部的山地与林地之间，航站楼与机坪在跑道一侧。
aso-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Asosa's runway lies among hills and woodland in western Ethiopia, with the terminal and apron alongside it.

aso-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 蓝色的玻璃幕墙上方立着白色机场名称，混凝土雨棚由交叉柱撑起，透过玻璃能看见值机柜台与候机座椅。
aso-chatgpt-01.webp.en: White airport lettering sits above a blue glass facade, concrete canopies carried on crossed columns, with check-in desks and waiting seats visible through the glazing.

aso-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 夕阳下从山坡俯瞰，一架双涡轮螺旋桨客机停在机坪上，绿顶平房与跑道铺在开阔的田野间，远处是群山。
aso-chatgpt-02.webp.en: From a hillside at sunset, a twin-turboprop airliner rests on the apron while green-roofed buildings and the runway spread across open farmland, hills beyond.

aso-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 傍晚暖光里，机场入口两侧的弧形石阶环抱着一座石盆，旗杆上飘着国旗，玻璃幕墙上写着机场的名字。
aso-chatgpt-03.webp.en: In warm evening light, twin curved stone staircases embrace a stone basin at the airport entrance, flags flying above and the airport name lettered across the glass.

aso-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 卫星影像中，一条跑道横穿茂密的绿色林地，周围是零散的农田与村落，看不出铺面的细节。
aso-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Satellite imagery shows a single runway cutting through dense green woodland, with scattered farmland and small settlements around it and no surface detail visible.
